knockRange.note: How near a body must be for a wave to bump it

hitStopMs.note: The hit lands: the bumped body holds, squashed and shaking, before it flies

knockDistance.note: How far a bump sends a body, the same at any frame rate

knockEase.note: 1 slides at one speed; higher leaves faster and eases into the stop

squash.note: How much a flying body stretches along the hit, and squashes when it stops

flashMs.note: How long the bumped body flashes white

shake.note: The camera's kick when you bump or are bumped

ringMs.note: How long a wave's ring lasts
